name: foomtree
title: foomtree
blurb: a recursive fractal generator — trees, snowflakes, triangles, and H-trees that spawn smaller copies of themselves. grow it level by level and watch the shape count double each time, tune depth, branch angle, and five color schemes, then save or share what you grew. this tick's theme box idea for "more of this type of thing, which themselves create more: singularity, RSI, FOOM."
